snippet.title: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection • Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection is out now on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S!
Learn more: https://commodore.net/games/alienbreed/
In 1991, Team17's Alien Breed brought sci-fi horror to the Commodore Amiga. Today, the Breed is back! Alien Breed 35th Anniversary Collection brings all six original games to modern platforms for the first time—complete with updated controls, new co-op modes, and a Virtual Museum filled to the brim with historical rarities.

▶ THE GAMES
• Alien Breed (1991)
• Alien Breed: Special Edition 92 (1992)
• Alien Breed II: The Horror Continues (1993)
• Alien Breed: Tower Assault (1994)
• Alien Breed 3D (1995)
• Alien Breed 3D II (1996)

▶ BUY NOW
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4870460/Alien_Breed_35th_Anniversary_Collection/
Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-gb/games/store/alien-breed-35th-anniversary/9njp5vnwjzxw
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10020426/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/alien_breed_35th_anniversary
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/alien-breed-35th-anniversary-collection-72bf03
Nintendo Switch: Coming Fall 2026

▶ WHAT'S NEW
• Modern dual-stick controls
• Brand-new Horde Mode
• Online co-op in Rush Mode
• Save states, screen filters, and rumble support

▶ THE VIRTUAL MUSEUM
Explore original physical media, marketing assets, soundtracks, and developer interviews. Includes a rare look at cancelled projects that never shipped—featuring design documents and concept art for Alien Breed PSP and Alien Breed RTS.

Download-to-own. No internet connection required to play.

#AlienBreed #Amiga #RetroGaming #Team17
